freeTier.limits: Free tier on gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-3-flash-preview and Gemma 4. Per-model RPM/TPM/RPD are no longer published; they are shown per project in AI Studio (aistudio.google.com/rate-limit). RPD resets at midnight Pacific.
freeTier.notes: No card needed (an active Google Cloud project is enough). gemini-4-argon is not on the free tier. Free-tier prompts and outputs are used to improve Google products. Since the 2026-03-23 terms only Paid Services may serve end users in the EEA/CH/UK (secondary source). OpenAI-compatible endpoint: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/ with Authorization: Bearer.

freeTier.limits: Free plan: openai/gpt-oss-120b, openai/gpt-oss-20b, qwen/qwen3.8-27b = 30 RPM / 1K RPD / 8K TPM / 200K TPD each. Limits are per organization.
freeTier.notes: No card. Phone verification at signup (secondary source). Vision: max 3 images per request, each image counts as 2,048 input tokens, so the 8K TPM free cap allows roughly 3 screenshots a minute.

freeTier.limits: Models whose id ends in :free: 20 requests/min; 50 requests/day with < 10 credits ever purchased, 1,000 requests/day once >= 10 credits purchased (one-time, lifetime total).
freeTier.notes: 19 free model ids on 2026-10-27 (the set rotates). A negative credit balance blocks free models too. GET /api/v1/key reports the free-model daily counter. Some upstream free providers may log/train; the privacy setting for free models is separate.

freeTier.limits: 10,000 Neurons/day free on Workers Free and Workers Paid (resets 00:00 UTC). Beyond that: Workers Paid at $0.011 per 1,000 Neurons.
freeTier.notes: No card for the free allocation. Kimi K2.6/K2.7-code, GLM-5.2/5.3/5.3-flash and DeepSeek V4.x models require Workers Paid or AI Gateway credits. The {account_id} placeholder must be filled in.

freeTier.limits: GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Flash (text) and GLM-4.6V-Flash (vision) are priced Free (input, cached input, output). Concrete RPM/TPM for the free models are not published.
freeTier.notes: Pay-as-you-go for everything else. Since 2026-10-16 standard API keys and GLM Coding Plan keys are managed separately.

freeTier.limits: Free mode (default for new accounts): API access with no credit card, limited included usage and rate limits. Exact per-model limits are shown only in the Admin Panel (API > Limits).
freeTier.notes: In Free mode Mistral may train on inputs/outputs unless you opt out (secondary source). Which models are reachable in Free mode is not documented per model.

freeTier.limits: Free hosted endpoints for NVIDIA Developer Program members; about 40 requests/minute per account (community-reported, not an official guarantee; varies by model and load). No credit system since 2025-09.
freeTier.notes: Evaluation/prototyping only per NVIDIA trial terms. Phone verification may be required (secondary source). Vision/tool support per model on NIM is UNVERIFIED; flags reflect the model's own capabilities.

freeTier.limits: Free Tier (no payment method linked): 20 RPM / 20 RPD / 200,000 tokens per day per model for DeepSeek-V3.1, Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, gpt-oss-120b and preview models DeepSeek-V3.2, gemma-4-31B-it.
freeTier.notes: Developer Tier (payment method linked): 60-240 RPM, 12K-48K RPD, 20M tokens/day across models. SambaNova's plans page says a payment method is needed to run first requests; the docs disagree.

freeTier.limits: Free Trial: $5 credits that expire 30 days after grant; 5 RPM / 30K uncached TPM / 90K total TPM / 1M tokens per hour / 1M tokens per day per model; free-trial context 64-65K.
freeTier.notes: A verified payment method is required to activate the API (no charge). Not a renewing free tier: after the credits expire you must buy credits.

freeTier.limits: Trial (evaluation) keys: 1,000 API calls per month; 20 requests/min per chat model.
freeTier.notes: Trial keys are for evaluation only, not production/commercial use.

freeTier.limits: Every generation request needs a key (sk_) and spends Pollen (about $1 per Pollen). Free Pollen comes from Quests on the enter.pollinations.ai dashboard; Quest Pollen works only on models that are not paid_only. No per-request rate limit on sk_ keys.
freeTier.notes: The old anonymous/no-key tier is gone. Model listing needs no key. The same endpoint also accepts Responses (/v1/responses, stateless) and Anthropic Messages (/v1/messages).

freeTier.limits: Monthly free credit (amount not stated on the current pricing page; earlier docs said $5 every 30 days - UNVERIFIED) on a subset of Free Tier models, with lower per-model rate limits (429 when exceeded).
freeTier.notes: Buying any credits moves the team to the paid tier and ends the monthly free credit. BYOK only on the paid tier. Gateway does not retain prompts.

freeTier.limits: Anonymous use without a key: 2 requests/min per IP per model. With a key: 400 requests/min per Public Cloud project per model (pay per token).
freeTier.notes: Whether anonymous calls to priced models are billed is not stated (UNVERIFIED); the models listed at $0 are guard/TTS/image models, not chat LLMs. EU (France) hosting.

freeTier.limits: First 1,000,000 tokens free (one-time bucket, not time-limited) plus 60 min of Whisper; then pay per token. With a payment method: 300 RPM / 200K TPM per model (secondary source).
freeTier.notes: EU (France) provider; does not train on API data. Facts from the free-llm-api-hub dataset (verified 2026-10-08); Scaleway's docs returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches on 2026-10-27.

freeTier.limits: New-user free quota (typically 1,000,000 tokens per model) for Singapore-region, International-scope models; valid 90 days from activation; one quota per account.
freeTier.notes: Only real-time inference is covered. Enable 'Free Quota Only' to avoid pay-as-you-go charges after the quota. Account information must be completed before activation.

freeTier.limits: 1,000,000 free tokens per developer (models consume it at different rates). Numeric RPM/TPM not published.
freeTier.notes: Uses the AI Studio Access Token as the API key. Paid Qianfan platform: https://qianfan.baidubce.com/v2 (third-party sources; UNVERIFIED).

freeTier.limits: No free tier: at least $1 recharge to start; a $5 voucher after $5 cumulative recharge (secondary sources).
freeTier.notes: Tier 0 limits are low (reported 3 RPM, 1 concurrent) - UNVERIFIED.

freeTier.limits: Free accounts get no included credits (purchase required). PRO and Team/Enterprise seats include $2.00/month of compute credits.
freeTier.notes: Credits apply only to requests 'Routed by Hugging Face', not to custom provider keys.

freeTier.limits: No free trial: platform access requires a minimum $15 first credit purchase.
freeTier.notes: Prism-ML/Ternary-Bonsai-27B is priced Free but still needs the platform minimum purchase.

freeTier.limits: Small trial credit ($1 per secondary source, UNVERIFIED); about 10 RPM without a payment method (secondary source).
freeTier.notes: Prepaid credits; spend tiers raise limits.

freeTier.limits: Inference needs a Pro plan (one-time $5+ deposit) or an Organization; Free-tier personal accounts get HTTP 403 inference_requires_pro.
freeTier.notes: Text models only: no vision.

freeTier.limits: Uses the Poe subscription's monthly points; add-on points can be bought. 500 requests/min.
freeTier.notes: No free API tier is documented.

freeTier.limits: Pay as you go ($0 plan, billed per token, 3 concurrent requests); Pro $20/mo includes $60 credits.
freeTier.notes: The older free starter allowance no longer appears on ollama.com/pricing (2026-10-27). OpenAI-compatible endpoint also at https://ollama.com/v1.
